## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes (if Rust changed)
- [ ] `pnpm deslop` reviewed (if UI changed) and remaining hits explained
- [ ] Works at a small viewport (≤ 800×600) and a large one (≥ 2560 wide)
- [ ] Keyboard reachable, focus visible
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
- [ ] AI-assisted authorship disclosed per `AI_USAGE_POLICY.md`
